scope: Export-only semantic comparison of selected no_backup/rime-user directory copies from pre-validation and final restored device backups. Original archives/user files and phone were not modified; preferences were not extracted or read.
engine: Host Darwin librime 1.17.0 levers export_user_dict, initialized with current packaged Android system resources; no sessions created and no keys processed.
canonicalization: Byte-sort nonempty UTF-8 export lines excluding lines starting #; append LF per line; compare SHA-256 and count. Full entry/code/frequency metadata lines retained in hash; no actual entries included in this report.
private_artifacts_permissions: Private extracted directories0700; actual exports and logs0600; remain private temporary files, excluded from repository.
limitations: Comparison covers existing pinyin_simp and wubi86 learned entries and their exported frequency metadata, not every private application state byte.
LevelDB manifest/CURRENT/LOG and user.yaml metadata can differ independently of equal exported dictionary entries.
